# Edge cases for the regex script scanners in script/syntax.py.
# Braces and hashes inside quoted strings, comments in every position a
# comment can occupy, and the trailing-backslash icon path that must not
# swallow its own closing quote.
focus_tree = {
	id = TST_edge_tree	# trailing comment after a value

	country = {
		factor = 0
		# a comment on its own line inside a block
		modifier = {
			add = 20
			original_tag = TST
		}
	}

	continuous_focus_position = { x = 20 y = 300 }	# and here

	focus = {
		id = TST_braces_in_string
		icon = "gfx\interface\goals\tst\"	# path ends in a backslash
		x = 0
		y = 0
		cost = 5
		available = {
			# comment as the first line of a raw block
			has_country_flag = "flag_with_{_and_}_and_#_inside"
			NOT = { has_war = yes }	# comment after a nested block
		}
		completion_reward = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = "reward } # tooltip"

			add_political_power = 50
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = TST_comment_between_keys
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_political_pressure
		x = 1
		y = 1
		relative_position_id = TST_braces_in_string
		# completion_reward = { add_stability = 0.5 }
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_braces_in_string }
		bypass = { has_country_flag = bypassed }
		# the commented-out block above must not be picked up as raw text
		completion_reward = {
			add_stability = 0.05
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = TST_hash_heavy
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_political_pressure
		x = 2
		y = 0
		relative_position_id = TST_braces_in_string
		cost = 7
		select_effect = { set_country_flag = "selected" }	# tail comment
		cancel = {
			has_country_flag = "flag # with hash"	# quoted, commented
		}
		completion_reward = {
			add_war_support = 0.02	# 2%
			#
		}
	}
}
